message: framing: `name` ends in "-guidelines" — names the document, not the capability; consider the activity beneath it.

frontmatter: `description` begins with `[`, which YAML reads as an indicator rather than text — quote the value.

frontmatter: `description` opens with a double quote but does not close — a quoted value must end with the same quote.
frontmatter: `description` opens with a single quote but does not close — a quoted value must end with the same quote.
frontmatter: `description` carries `\q`, which YAML does not define as an escape inside a double-quoted value — use single quotes, or double the backslash.
frontmatter: `description` carries an unescaped `"` inside a double-quoted value — write it as `\"`.
frontmatter: `description` carries an unpaired `'` inside a single-quoted value — double it to `''` to mean a literal quote.
